notice: This profile is the Korg ARP 2600 FS MIDI reissue, not the original pre-MIDI ARP 2600 or a TTSH build. Synthesis sections are extracted from the NYU ARP 2600 tactile guide pp. 6-18 and checked against the FS manual; FS-specific filter type, side connections and ARP 3620 controls come from Korg. DIN MIDI IN receives notes only, ignoring velocity. USB receives notes and pitch bend and transmits keyboard notes with fixed velocity 64; panel sliders and switches do not transmit MIDI. No analog panel CC assignments are supplied. Set the MIDI channel using mode switches 1-4 (factory channel 1). Consult Korg driver requirements for USB. The 8-pin keyboard cable and all CV/gate/audio patch jacks are not MIDI. The combined cabinet/keyboard drawing is schematic; note positions use virtual defaults and can require octave adjustment. Select the profile manually for a DIN interface.
